digest.component_or_area: retry dispatcher, eval runner, metrics registry
propositions: Parameter timeout_s is declared in _call_with_retry signature but never read in function body, causing callers who pass timeout_s=N intending it for the wrapped Jira client to have the value swallowed instead of forwarded through **kwargs.
Parameter dirty in run_eval signature is declared but never read in function body and no caller in src/ or tests/ passes it, falsely implying eval-provenance source can be switched.
Metric specs module_size_trend and commit_cadence_trend carry compute=_no_data_yet returning None, so evaluate always yields Unavailable with no real data source landed.
Future real implementations of module_size_trend or commit_cadence_trend would be silently skipped during registration because the ids are already held by stub specs, with no error or warning raised.
Test test_trend_unavailable asserts the placeholder metrics stay Unavailable, acting as a change-detector test pinning stubs in place.
